cohort: Pregnant women (n=474), postpartum women (n=403), and a control group of non-pregnant women (n=200)
finding: The prevalence of constipation was significantly higher in pregnant women and postpartum women compared to non-pregnant women, but bowel function returned to or below that of non-pregnant women by one month postpartum.
mod_finding: A few days after delivery, the prevalence of constipation was higher after caesarean section compared to vaginal delivery.
